verdict.rationale: Trello is a project-management and kanban SaaS. An agent verifying its own code changes by navigating an app and capturing before-and-after screenshots belongs to coding agents and browser-automation tools, not to this product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Trello ships such a capability; the MCP server, REST API and Power-Ups provide board and card access, not app navigation or screenshot capture.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent verify its own implementation by navigating the app and capturing before-and-after screenshots
